exposure: postplacental IUD (PPIUD) after vaginal (VD) or cesarean delivery (CD)
outcome: visualization or palpation of IUD strings
need for ultrasound evaluation of IUD
cohort: 210 women who received a TCu380A postplacental IUD (PPIUD) after vaginal or cesarean delivery
finding: Women who underwent cesarean delivery had significantly higher rates of IUD retention at 6 weeks postpartum compared to those who had a vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Women are more likely to retain a PPIUD after cesarean delivery compared to vaginal delivery, but are also more likely to have nonvisible strings and require pelvic ultrasound evaluation.
